children: Sen.
Patty Murray

(D-Wash.) urged Democrats to pursue universal health care, arguing that reversing Republican-backed cuts and restoring existing protections would not be enough to address America’s health care challenges.
Murray Calls For Sweeping Health Care Reforms
On Saturday, in a post on
X
, Murray described Republicans’ health care strategy as "death by a thousand cuts" and said Democrats must be more ambitious than offering temporary solutions.
"We have got to reverse the Medicaid cuts that are shutting down our hospitals," Murray said in a video accompanying the post.
She also called for restoring Affordable Care Act (ACA) tax credits that help families afford health insurance.
Murray further criticized what she described as President
Donald Trump’s
plan to use artificial intelligence to cut seniors off from their Medicare benefits.
"But we can’t stop there because if Republicans’ health care strategy is death by a thousand cuts, Democrats have to be more than the party of a thousand band-aids," she said.
She called for a "robust public option and universal coverage," arguing that Democrats should pursue broader structural changes rather than rely solely on reversing Republican policies.
Republicans’ health care strategy is ‘death by a thousand cuts.’ Democrats have to be more than the party of a thousand band-aids.
It’s way past time we get to universal health care in America.

US Health Care Costs Surge
Earlier this month, the Kobeissi Letter said

params.linkText: U.S. health care costs had risen
